reviewed_behaviors: AnimationPlayer::new validates and privately retains matching node/rest/channel tables; both clip indices and finite clocks are checked before scratch writes, including zero/one weight endpoints.
Each input starts from its own rest copy; missing channels cannot inherit prior frame or other clip values. Single-sample extraction preserves original interpolation arithmetic and order.

Finite weight is constrained to [0,1]; exact endpoints call the original single-sample path. Interior translation/scale interpolate in local TRS, and normalized pinned glam 0.32.1 slerp uses the shortest arc before hierarchy composition.

publish fills only staged local/global/joint arrays, checks composed values, then swaps all arrays together; failed composition preserves live state and a later successful call recomputes all staged values.
The added retained TRS array is counted in retained_bytes; successful sampling uses preallocated arrays, not heap allocation.
